subject: MediTrack pilot: hosted API pricing concession request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@meditrack.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MediTrack pilot: hosted API pricing concession request

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a great conversation yesterday. Per our call, attaching a lightweight term sheet and a short usage forecast so you can share with internal stakeholders. Key ask from your side: a pricing position that makes the pilot financially viable while keeping a path to standard pricing on renewal.

Ask: can you confirm whether a single consolidated PO is preferred and any procurement lead times we should factor?

What we propose (initial ask to Deal Desk / Exec):
- 25% off list Hosted API unit pricing for the first 12 months (pilot + onboarding period)
- Commitment: minimum monthly spend USD 12,000 during the 12-month window
- Net 60 payment terms for pilot (we can discuss 30/45 if procurement requires it)
- One joint review at month 9 to agree renewal pricing/volumes

Why this makes sense:
- Strategic US healthcare customer for us; success here will be a public case for clinical text/EMR automation use cases
- Expected ramp to ~2M tokens/month after month 3 (see forecast)
- Low initial integration support required from Redwood — we can accept a phased SLA for the pilot

If this is more than you can accept up front, we can propose a tiered concession (25% for months 1–6, 15% for months 7–12) — but wed like to avoid complex per-call negotiation.

Attached: meditrack_term_sheet_v1.pdf; meditrack_usage_forecast.xlsx; meditrack_po_template.pdf

Next step: if procurement/legal need a term variant, tell me the must-haves and I'll loop in Legal/Finance. If helpful, would you like us to route a one-time exec approval request to pricing/sales leadership?

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@meditrack.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MediTrack pilot: hosted API pricing concession request

Hannah —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the materials. A couple quick clarifying questions from procurement/legal before we can sign:
1) Is the 25% figure a final commercial floor or a request to your deal desk?
2) We need to confirm data handling (SSO, data residency is important for a subset of records) — if you can include a short security addendum that would speed legal review.
3) Our PO template (attached) requires 90-day net payment on vendor-side signoff; would Redwood accept Net 90 for this pilot?

Were a bit stretched on cash in Q3, so the discount helps. This pilot is intended to be net-new and public case material for our platform partners. If 25% requires exec signoff, please escalate and let us know the expected timeline — procurement wants to finalize budget by end of next week.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Gomez
Director of Product | MediTrack
alex.gomez@meditrack.ai

[Attachment: meditrack_po_template.pdf]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MediTrack pilot: hosted API pricing concession request (exec sign-off asked)

Ben / Neha —

Looping you in — MediTrack (DEAL-4821) is asking for a 25% concession on Hosted API list rates for a 12-month pilot. They also asked whether Redwood would accept Net 90 (their PO template) — procurement is pushing for Net 90 but Alex indicated 90-day is a hard ask on their side.

Rationale for concession:
- Strategic healthcare use case; strong reference potential and partner integration pipeline
- Forecasted steady-state usage ~2M tokens/month (see attached forecast)
- Close timeline: procurement wants decision by 2028-07-03 to lock budget

Proposed approval request to Exec (what Im asking you to consider):
- One-time concession: up to 25% off hosted API unit pricing for first 12 months
- Requirement: committed minimum USD 12k/month during the 12-month period
- Payment terms: prefer Net 60; if we agree Net 90, require a pre-funded credit hold or escrow (finance will need to weigh in)
- Legal: include our standard security addendum; require audit-rights clause and explicit data handling scope limited to model inputs for the pilot

Attachments: meditrack_term_sheet_v1.pdf; meditrack_usage_forecast.xlsx; meditrack_po_template.pdf

Can you confirm whether youre comfortable with the 25% level? If we need to reduce to 20% to avoid escalation, I can propose a tier (25% months 1–6, 15% months 7–12). Procurement needs an answer by EOW.

Thanks —
Hannah

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MediTrack pilot: hosted API pricing concession request (exec sign-off asked)

Hannah / Ben —

Thanks for the clear context and the forecast. Ive reviewed the numbers and the strategic rationale. Approve a one-time concession with the following binding conditions:

1) Concession: up to 25% off Hosted API list rates for months 1–12
2) Commitment: MediTrack must sign a 12-month pilot with a minimum monthly spend of USD 12,000 (we will pro-rate the first month if start date mid-month)
3) Payment terms: Net 60 standard; if MediTrack insists on Net 90, require Finance to place a 1.5x rolling credit hold on the account until 90-day receivables are cleared (Finance to advise exact mechanism)
4) Legal/security: include Redwood security addendum and a scoped audit-rights clause limited to pilot-related data. No broad data residency commitments — we will document permitted processing locations in the addendum.
5) Renewal: schedule a commercial review at month 9; if usage < 80% of forecast we reserve the right to renegotiate pricing or terminate with 30 days notice.

Operational notes:
- Sales to update Deal Desk with final term sheet and committed MRR target (DEAL-4821)
- Finance to create a one-time discount code and record the concession in the billing system
- Legal to review the PO template and the security addendum; expect a short turnaround if redlines are minimal

Hannah — please send me the final term sheet incorporating these conditions and Ill mark this as Exec-approved. Ben — FYI, please coordinate implementation with Finance.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

[cc Ben Carter]
